solids_note: one compound of closed solids: plinth, 2 vessel chains (shell, heads, tubesheets, separator ring, top cap), the 2 19-tube bundles at running clearance, demister pads, compressor envelopes and the nozzle stubs; every union partner overlaps volumetrically, so the mesh reads back closed and manifold

a_hx.basis: A-HX: the bundle area is reported drawn against booked; the node carries the 8.779 kW latent duty, so the booked area is the calculated figure (latent / (U 2.8 x 5 K), PERRY9_EVAP class, stub_activation X-MFG-38 pattern) and the drawn bundle carries it at +1.7 %

holdup_L.basis: the duty section 2 working volume (2 h, 0.0138 m3 book) against the model sump; reported, not used as a residence time beyond the duty's own claim (A-VES rule)

redundancy.rule: 2 x 100 %, standby still on the same feed header (X-RED-05); both modules drawn (installed)
